Ground team intel
SABER (friendly)EnemyCivilian crowds
The village is full of people this map doesn't track. Enemies appear only once SABER confirms them; "movement" calls stay off the map until SABER sees weapons. Any heat the gunner sees that isn't on your map is unknown. Tap a callout to find it. Talk the gunner on: grid, nearest landmark, compass direction, then the target. The gunner sees only heat. This map doesn't know what the gunner has already killed, so ask.
Build v0.18 · co-op gunship · plays on phones

Pylon Turn

You orbit a village at 900 meters. Everyone down there is a white smudge of heat. The gunner can shoot but can't tell friend from enemy. The radio operator knows who's who but can't shoot. Keep the ground team alive until the bird lifts off, about ten minutes.

Playing as a crew

Each code is a different village, objective, route and enemy plan. No network needed: both devices enter the same code, someone counts "3, 2, 1," and you both press Start together. The mission plays out identically on both screens. If units drift apart, the radio operator can nudge the clock a second either way.

What this prototype tests

Only the core question: is talking a gunner onto targets tense and fun? Loaders are automated here (the reload timers are where human loaders will go), and there's no plane interior yet.
